About Me

Behind Every
Great Thumbnail

I'm Mohamed — a 18-year-old graphic designer with 5 years of hands-on experience building scroll-stopping visuals for creators worldwide. I started designing at 13 because I was obsessed with why some videos get clicked and others don't.

That obsession became a career. Today I specialise exclusively in YouTube & Instagram thumbnails — and I've helped 400+ creators dramatically improve their CTR, grow their audiences, and convert more viewers into paying clients.

Every thumbnail I design is a strategic asset: built around colour psychology, contrast science, and platform-specific trends — not just what "looks nice." The result? Thumbnails that actually perform.

How It Works

Simple Process,
Powerful Results

From brief to delivery — a clear workflow that gets you high-performance thumbnails with zero stress.

01
💬
Brief & Brief

You tell me your niche, channel style, and video topic. I ask the right questions to understand exactly what your audience responds to.

02
🎨
Design & Craft

I build the thumbnail with strategic colour, bold typography, and CTR-tested compositions. Every element has a reason to be there.

03
🔁
Revise & Refine

Not happy? I revise until it's exactly right. Your satisfaction is the only metric I care about at this stage.

04
🚀
Deliver & Grow

You get high-res final files ready to upload. Then we watch the CTR climb together. Most clients re-order within the first week.
